note: The `*_initialized_prefix_len`, `*_read_bytes`, and `*_store_bytes` fields are semantic views over the same vulnerable-version source scalar `MI->op1_size`: Stage 04 measures defined-prefix length with `__msan_test_shadow(&MI->op1_size, sizeof(MI->op1_size))` and uses `sizeof(MI->op1_size)` for the one-byte read/store width. `*_field_addr` is the address of that same scalar, emitted only as an alias witness for transition assertions. `copy_guard.zero_literal` is the literal `0` from the vulnerable guard `if (MI->op1_size == 0)`.
